tools.name: search_games
tools.description: Search Zadely’s AI-made browser games by text, genre, credited AI tool, engine, multiplayer, or phone support. Classic ports of commercial games are not searchable here. Each result includes pageUrl (cite this) and playUrl (where the creator hosts the game), plus credited AI tools and engine.

tools.name: get_game
tools.description: Look up one AI-made browser game by its Zadely slug, the last segment of https://zadely.com/games/<slug>/. Returns the description, credited AI tools and engine, creator, how it was made (with sources), controls, and both pageUrl and playUrl. Unknown slugs and classic ports return an error and no pl

tools.name: list_trending
tools.description: List AI-made browser games Zadely currently marks as trending, most in demand first. Classic ports are omitted even when the public trending page includes them. Each result includes pageUrl, playUrl, credited AI tools, and engine.

tools.name: random_game
tools.description: Pick one AI-made browser game at random. Optional genre, AI tool, engine, multiplayer, and phone filters use the same matching rules as search_games. The result includes pageUrl, playUrl, credited AI tools, and engine.

tools.name: list_jam_winners
tools.description: List AI-made jam winners and category awardees tracked by Zadely, including Vibe Jam and the AI Browser Game Jam. Filter with a jam name such as "Vibe Jam 2026", "vibe-jam-2025", or "AI Browser Game Jam". Each row includes the award, credited AI tools, engine, pageUrl, and playUrl.
